evidence_spans: Furthermore, annealing restores the linear optical dispersion (n and k) approaching that of epitaxially grown GaP with estimated plane wave absorption loss of 0.9 dB/cm at 1550 nm in the telecom C-band.

After annealing at 600 °C for 12 h, the refractive-index n of the thin film shifts toward that of bulk GaP and becomes nearly identical to the pristine bulk GaP at longer wavelengths.
